## Gotchas learned this session
- Auto-mode classifier denied a compound `git push && ./deploy/deploy.sh`. Brendan added `Bash(./deploy/deploy.sh)`
  to `.claude/settings.local.json`; run deploy.sh as its own command. deploy.sh refuses uncommitted tracked changes —
  commit STATE.md first.
- `herdr agent start` right after `pane split` can fail with `agent_pane_busy`: sleep ~4s first.
- Idle reviewer panes vanish on their own sometimes (happened to `rev` w1:p1S). Check `panes.sh status` before prompting.
- herdr shows Claude panes `idle` while a background shell runs; read the screen before assuming stuck.
- `sed` with `|`-heavy STATE rows breaks; use small python edits.
- Turso CLI is logged in as `deasa` on the Mac; `.env` has BACKUP_TURSO_URL/TOKEN, BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT (never print).
